headline: ExxonMobil Urged to Rethink Papua New Guinea Gas Project Over Bat Risk
summary: A law firm working with impacted landowners warned that one of the world's rarest bats could be at risk if ExxonMobil proceeds with a gas project in Papua New Guinea.
why: ExxonMobil is a major multinational oil and gas corporation. Environmental and regulatory challenges in extraction projects can lead to delays, cost overruns, and reputational risks.

impacts.name: ExxonMobil
impacts.why: Environmental concerns raised over its Papua New Guinea gas project.
